blocks.raw: <Tip>NHA produces housing (sites-and-services, core, medium-rise). RA 10884 requires developers to dedicate 15–20% of project cost to balanced housing. Self-help succeeds when community organization is strong (Turner principle: Housing by People).</Tip>
